settings.heading: We wash buildings for a living
settings.content:
Maximum Wash Ltd cleans exteriors all day, every day — houses, apartment blocks, commercial buildings. After enough years watching supermarket products under-deliver, we made the one we'd actually use at home: gentle on the building and the garden, brutal on moss, mould and grime, and designed so the weather does the labour instead of you.

Soak n Go is that product. Professional thinking, hose-end simple.
